what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Planned rule paths include `.github/workflows/**/*` outside the `.sh` edit surface
scenario_or_breakage: The issue asks for an always-loaded rule plus a point-of-edit reminder when `.sh` files are edited. This path also loads the script policy for workflow YAML and requirements files, adding noise and scope beyond the request.
suggested_fix: Drop `.github/workflows/**/*` and keep the shell-strict-mode `.sh` path set.

what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Thin-wrapper wording permits direct delegation to arbitrary Python modules
scenario_or_breakage: The existing migration contract makes `python/cli.py` the canonical entrypoint. Allowing wrappers to call another module adds a second entrypoint pattern that the feature does not need.
suggested_fix: Limit thin-wrapper wording to delegation through `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/python/cli.py" ...`.
